name: slide
about: The avatar walks up the steps of the thing, sits at the top, and slides down it to the bottom, then stands up and cheers.
code:
let s = args.thing || w.find('slide', { near: me })
if (!s) { s = w.make('slide', { near: me }) ; yield* w.wait(0.5) }
const fx = Math.sin(s.yaw), fz = Math.cos(s.yaw), h = s.size.d / 2
const back = { x: s.x - fx * (h + 0.3), z: s.z - fz * (h + 0.3) }
const end = { x: s.x + fx * (h + 0.3), z: s.z + fz * (h + 0.3) }
yield* me.walkTo(back, { near: 0.1 })
yield* me.turnTo(end)
const top = s.anchor('top'), sx = me.x, sz = me.z
w.sound('step')
yield* w.during(1.5, (k) => {
  me.x = w.lerp(sx, top.x, k); me.z = w.lerp(sz, top.z, k); me.y = top.y * k
  const a = Math.sin(k * 20) * 0.6
  me.pose.legL.swing = a; me.pose.legR.swing = -a; me.pose.armL.swing = 1.5 - a; me.pose.armR.swing = 1.5 + a
})
yield* me.poseTo({ legL: { swing: 1.5, bend: 0 }, legR: { swing: 1.5, bend: 0 }, armL: { swing: 0, raise: 0.4 }, armR: { swing: 0, raise: 0.4 } }, 0.3)
me.feel('happy'); me.say('Wheee!')
w.sound('whoosh')
yield* w.during(1.2, (k) => {
  const e = k * k
  me.x = w.lerp(top.x, end.x, e); me.z = w.lerp(top.z, end.z, e); me.y = top.y * (1 - e)
  me.pose.armL.raise = me.pose.armR.raise = 2.5 * k; me.pose.lean = -0.3
})
me.y = 0
w.puff({ x: me.x, y: 0.05, z: me.z, kind: 'dust', count: 10 })
yield* me.rest(0.3)
me.feel('happy'); w.sound('yay'); me.say('Yay!')
yield* me.poseTo({ armL: { swing: 3 }, armR: { swing: 3 }, squash: 0.85 }, 0.15)
yield* me.jump(0.5)
w.puff({ at: me, kind: 'confetti' })
yield* me.rest()
